visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male performer wearing a red and yellow striped vest over a white undershirt and grey jeans sings passionately into a silver microphone on a stage with a large red banner background. He points and gestures with his hands towards the camera and audience. An inset rectangular frame appears showing five band members in a rehearsal room setting with various instruments including keyboards and guitars. (2) The scene shifts to close-ups of specific band members. A drummer with short black hair and glasses wears a black shirt with a graphic print, hitting cymbals in a dimly lit studio. A female vocalist with short dark hair and a black zip-up hoodie sings into a microphone against a white wall decorated with line-art drawings of characters. (3) On the performance stage, a male singer in a white ribbed tank top smiles while singing to a crowd. Other band members are visible in fast cuts, including a female guitarist with long dark hair and a male bassist in a black and white striped long-sleeve shirt. Vibrant stage lights in blue, red, and yellow illuminate the performers and instruments. (4) Aerial drone footage captures crashing white waves against dark rocky shores and a wide sandy beach during the day. The scene transitions to a night-time wide shot of a massive outdoor crowd gathered in front of a brightly lit stage under a cloudy night sky. Colorful light beams emanate from the stage into the audience.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotional advertisement for the upcoming 'Moonlit Sea Concert' at the East Coast Land Arts Festival in Taitung. It leverages dynamic live performance footage and rehearsal snippets of the band '真的混蛋' (Real Bastard) to build excitement, while a fast-paced narration details the date, location, and collaborative guests to encourage attendance.
